expectations.text: Concludes the layout is over-split for an AI-heavy codebase
expectations.evidence: "this is over-split. For a single small component, splitting one logical unit across five files is a net negative — and that's especially true in a codebase where AI assistants do a lot of the editing."

expectations.text: Recommends merging tightly-coupled view+logic+types into one component file
expectations.evidence: "Collapse to a single file... UserBadge.tsx # everything"; "types + logic + styles + component, in that reading order."

expectations.text: Identifies the dumb-view-props-shaped-by-sibling smell (cross-file context the agent won't fetch)
expectations.evidence: Discusses 'context assembly cost' and that 'the view doesn't make sense without the logic,' but frames it as working-set size; does not identify the agent's reluctance to open adjacent siblings / props-shaped-elsewhere smell.

expectations.text: Keeps genuinely isolatable styles as a defensible separate file (does not blanket-merge everything)
expectations.evidence: Recommends collapsing to one file with 'types + logic + styles + component' folded together; only says co-located styles are fine 'until they're large' — blanket-merges styles in the actual recommendation rather than defending them as separate.
